config.notes: UC qualification pages (www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/academic-study/qualifications/...). No programme or CRICOS code is printed, so patterns use labels only. Two layouts: (a) "Degree Structure - Start ... / POINTS / Degree Structure - Duration ..."; (b) banner "International students START 13 July 2027 POINTS 180 DURATION 1 year full time". Fee: the 2026 line of the International (students) fee box ("tuition fee estimate", "Special Programme Fee" or "annual fee estimate"), directly after the International label or after one earlier-year line, and only when it is a 120-point (one full-time year) figure. THE YEAR 2026 IS FIXED IN THE FEE PATTERN AND MUST BE MOVED ON EACH YEAR. 60-, 150- and 180-point figures are whole-qualification amounts and ranges are ambiguous, so they are skipped on purpose. Domestic and SSL boxes are never read. Study level: breadcrumb after Qualifications (e.g. Bachelor's degree). IELTS is not on these pages (they link to central undergraduate/postgraduate language requirement pages). Campus and delivery mode are not printed. Some education/teaching pages carry no start line. 5 Oct 13:02 (international view): UC qualification pages print the domestic and the international boxes on the same page (no address variant); the fee pattern now reads the newest international 120-point year shown: 2027, or 2026 when no 2027 line is printed (the year is stored with the fee). course_title_strip removes the catalogue suffix "(Level n)" so a page rebound by hand to its own qualification page is confirmed by title. Delivery mode and IELTS are not printed on these pages. Titles: "Maori"/"Māori" is taken off both the catalogue title and the page heading before they are compared (the catalogue holds no macron). Entry requirement (5 Oct 15:22, for review): the "Entry requirements" panel text (starts with the qualification name). No exit award with full-time years printed (MTchLn exit to PGDipTchLn has no years); no whole-course fee printed (fees are per 120 points).
